definitions.explanation: A person who works behind the scenes to support an event, production, or project. Also refers to the role itself.

examples.japanese: {裏方|うらかた}として{働|はたら}いた。
イベントの{成功|せいこう}は{裏方|うらかた}のおかげだ。
examples.english: The success of the event is thanks to the behind-the-scenes staff.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{目立|めだ}たないが、チームの{裏方|うらかた}として{欠|か}かせない{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: He doesn't stand out, but he is indispensable as the behind-the-scenes support for the team.

notes:
USAGE: {裏方|うらかた} can refer to the person, the role, or the general concept of behind-the-scenes work. It carries a positive nuance of essential but unsung contribution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏方|うらかた}に{徹|てっ}する: to devote oneself to behind-the-scenes work
- {裏方|うらかた}として{支|ささ}える: to support from behind the scenes
- {裏方|うらかた}{仕事|しごと}: backstage work

Originally a theater term for stagehands and backstage crew, it is now used broadly for any support role.
